title: Lesson
description: A lesson for Lesson Maker: the lesson plan, then sections of slides, each optionally split into subsections. Agents write it; people edit on top. Every field is always present, so each slide maps onto the same form whatever its layout; fields a layout does not show keep their text. Text is plain; new lines are allowed everywhere.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the file follows.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across all sections, subsections and slides in the lesson. Never shown to learners or used to refer to slides in prose.

plan.description: The lesson plan every slide follows. The chat never changes it unless asked to change the plan.

outcomes.description: What learners can do after the lesson.

teachingPrinciples.description: Rules every slide follows, e.g. one new idea per slide.

progression.description: The first-principles steps the lesson builds through, in order.

section.description: A section. Its name is its title slide's title.

titleSlide.description: The section's linked title slide, always shown first; its title is the section's name.

slides.description: The section's own slides, after its title slide and before its subsections.

subsections.description: Subsections in order. They do not nest further.

subsection.description: A subsection of a section. Its name is its title slide's title.

titleSlide.description: The subsection's linked title slide, always shown first; its title is the subsection's name.

slide.description: One slide. Layouts show: points-image = title, text (points), image; image-sentence = image, text (one sentence); title = title; title-image = title, text (subtitle), tagline, image; statement = text; before-after = image (before), afterImage, beforeCaption, afterCaption.

title.description: The slide's title (shown by the title, title-image and points-image layouts) or, otherwise, its name in the outline.

layout.description: How the slide is drawn; see the slide description for the fields each layout shows.

text.description: Points (points-image, one per line, may start with '- '), the sentence (image-sentence, one sentence), the statement (statement) or the subtitle (title-image).

tagline.description: title-image: the short line under the subtitle, such as the session it opens. Optional.

imageSide.description: points-image and title-image: which side the image sits on.

sentencePosition.description: image-sentence: whether the sentence sits above or below the image.

image.description: The image (points-image, image-sentence) or the before image (before-after).

beforeCaption.description: before-after: caption under the before image.

afterCaption.description: before-after: caption under the after image.

purpose.description: Teaching plan: why the slide is here, e.g. which progression step it serves. Not shown to learners.

speakerNotes.description: The presenter's script for this slide: the words they will say aloud, written as a short speech in the first person, in full spoken sentences and paragraphs. Not a list of points, no bullets and no headings such as 'Key points:'; a stage cue may go in [brackets]. Never shown to learners.

comments.description: The author's review comments on this slide: changes they want, written while reviewing. Not shown to learners. When you make the change a comment asks for, clear the comment (an empty string); leave a comment you could not act on, so what is left is still to do. Never write comments of your own.

locked.description: Set by the author only. true freezes the slide: leave it exactly as it is, in the same section or subsection; never delete or move it, and never set or clear this field. Optional; written only when true.

concept.description: What the image teaches and shows: the brief a picture is generated from.

style.description: How a picture for this image is drawn: generic is a flat, clean diagram; xiaohei follows the Ian Xiaohei illustration skill (hand-drawn, white background, the Xiaohei character doing the idea). Optional; absent means generic. Lesson Maker always writes it.

picture.description: The picture file, or null when there is none yet. Agents keep existing pictures or set null; new pictures come from generation or attachment in the app.

prompt.description: The exact prompt the picture was generated from.

model.description: The image model that generated it.

assetPath.description: A PNG path relative to the lesson file's folder, without '..', e.g. caching.lesson.assets/S-3-image.png.
